about:
# Wanderer Training

What your trainers have for you, and what it will cost. Made for World of Warcraft Forever.
An extension of [Wanderer](https://github.com/Jaecko/wanderer): it needs Wanderer 1.4 or later.

- Its own window (opened from Wanderer's bar and menu, a button on your spellbook, a key of yours or /wtraining): your class spells, weapon skills and demon tomes, in sections: to learn now, an earlier rank first, level by level, with a talent, set aside.
- Three sums to plan ahead: now, at the next level that brings something, and everything left; your gold beside them. Prices with your reputation's discount.
- What you play counts: choose your specialization (several at once, the bear and the cat apart for a feral druid). Spells of another one stay shown, can be bought, and counted if you wish: it guides, it never blocks.
- Your talents planned point by point, as the game's rules allow, the next one said at each level.
- The closest class trainer or weapon master pinned on your map; at the trainer, what counts learned in one click.
- The prices your trainer really asks, kept once seen there; a savings goal of your own beside the sums (riding at level 40 in one click).
- In your spell tooltips, the next rank: its level and its price, and for a spell outside what you play, why in one line. Older ranks on your bars and in your macros updated in one click.

Built on the data of [What's Training](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/whats-training) (MIT), with trainer places from CMaNGOS (GPL v3) and pfQuest (MIT); see CREDITS.md. Free software under the GNU GPL v3 or later.

Download: [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/wanderer-training). More on [wanderer-addon.com](https://wanderer-addon.com/).

releases.notes:
# Wanderer Training 1.4.13

### Changed
- With a controller, a line says the talent calculator opens beside the game's talents: open them with their key first.
- With the game's look (a choice under Wanderer's Appearance): the training page, the talent planner and its order list drawn with the game's own parts, its lit and chosen rows, its dividers and colors. Needs Wanderer 1.4.89.

# Wanderer Training 1.4.12

### New
- Talent calculator: the points of a plan can be moved in the order list, dragged to another level or one level at a time with their arrows; a move that would break the tree's rules is refused, with the reason.

### Changed
- The talent planner's level steps with a minus and a plus; Count again shows an undo sign; Rename a goal shows a pencil.
- Shift+click on a spell in the Training page or at the trainer links it in the chat.
- The window is titled Training and plays its open and close sounds.
- Talent order rows beyond the level you look at are easier to read.
- At every trainer (professions, weapons, riding), anything can be left out like your class's spells: right click or its ..., Leave out; it is then never bought with the others.

### Fixed
- At a hunter's pet trainer, prices are the pet's training points (as the game shows them), never gold, and learn all goes as far as the points go.
- Learning a new profession asks first, in the game's own words.
- At a profession trainer, your rank shows beside the trainer's name.
- The Calculator button on the talent window is hidden while Wanderer Training is off.
- At a trainer, a spell held back says the right reason: an earlier rank only when it is one, the skill named.
- Moving a point of a talent plan moves the one its row shows.

# Wanderer Training 1.4.5

### Changed
- A finer look across the family: one palette for every color, clearer contrast on dark windows and on parchment, the same words in every language.
- "Put down what you are holding first", no longer naming the mouse.

# Wanderer Training 1.4.3

### New
- Controller support: the talent calculator takes the controller and starts on Simulate; the triggers switch to the game's talent tree and back, and the right button closes the game's talents with the calculator. Needs Wanderer 1.4.36 or later.

### Fixed
- Talents bought at the trainer no longer leave the trainer's buttons disabled.
- A stray highlight in the talent calculator is gone.

# Wanderer Training 1.4.1

### Fixed
- The talent calculator's last tab no longer sticks out of its panel.
